text: Why empirical speedup is lower
textPreview: Why empirical speedup is lower

text:
• MPI collective latency rises with rank count
• Rank 0 still merges and writes the result
• Memory bandwidth and scheduling contend at high worker counts
• Amdahl assumes an ideal fixed serial fraction

text: Q&A
textPreview: Q&A

text: Open MPI enables distributed-memory execution across nodes, but this fine-grained kernel pays communication and root-aggregation overhead. Hybrid OpenMP improves local compute throughput; oversubscription reduces efficiency.
